note: Set A is slightly better as it generally maintains correct entity types (e.g., distinguishing angles from beams), whereas Set B frequently misidentifies section markers (A1, C1) as physical columns or grid lines (e.g., 'Column A1', 'Grid C1'). Both sets contain approximately 5 wrong claims, primarily involving misattributed section numbers or locations (e.g., Set A assigns the 37'-6" span to Section 3 instead of 4; Set B identifies the top W10X15 beam as 'bottom'). Set A provides more precise dimension extractions with correct unit conversions.
